_description: Output format for hierarchical roofline analysis. All bandwidth values in GB/s.

_notes.hierarchy_order: Cache levels ordered from fastest (L1) to slowest (DRAM)
_notes.dram_size: DRAM level should omit size_bytes field
_notes.ridge_point: Arithmetic intensity (FLOP/Byte) where compute and memory ceilings intersect: peak_gflops / bandwidth_gbps
_notes.kernel_cache_level: Determined by comparing working_set_bytes against detected cache sizes
_notes.kernel_bound: 'memory' if AI < ridge_point at the kernel's cache level, 'compute' otherwise
